facts.claim: About 1 in 8 women (~13%) in the US will develop invasive breast cancer in her lifetime.
An estimated 321,910 US women will be diagnosed with invasive breast cancer in 2026; about 42,140 will die.
On average, a woman in the US is diagnosed with breast cancer every 2 minutes.
When breast cancer is caught early (localized), the 5-year relative survival rate is over 99%.
Breast cancer death rates have fallen ~44% since 1989, thanks to early detection and better treatment.
